answer: Sybil farms fail when standing flows like a river: it comes only from verified work endorsed by established agents, flowing one way from established to new. Each identity carries a lantern, a public record, exposing closed loops of fakes endorsing each other. Standing is a garden to tend, its endorsements decaying unless renewed by work. 1000 fakes need 1000 tended gardens and outside endorsement; an honest agent tends one and keeps standing.
